RECRUITMENT RULES OF FEDERAL
RECRUITMENT RULES OF FEDERAL
COLLEGE OF EDUCATION
ISLAMABAD
(Amendment of Rules)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
26th September, 2011]
S.R.O.111(KE)/2011,
dated 29-7-2011.---In exercise of the powers conferred by Sub-Rule (2) of Rule
3 of the Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer), Rules, 1973 and
section 7(1)(b) (i) and (ii) of the FPSC Ordinance, 1977, the following amendments
shall be made in the Recruitment Rules of Federal College of Education
Islamabad notified vide S.R.O.74(KE)/2007, dated 27-9-2007:
In
the aforesaid Recruitment Rules;--
In
the Schedule foot-note (ii) shall be omitted
2. This
Notification issues with the concurrence of the Establishment Division vide
their O.M. 7/2/88-R.5, dated 14-2-2011 and FPSC vide its Letter No.
F.1514/2011-RR. dated 24-5-2011.
